stories.summary: Apiiro reports finding 2,539 real secrets across 1,994 public repositories after coding-agent approvals stored exact commands in local project settings. In 1,122 of 104,185 public Claude settings files, its scanners found a real secret. The company says automatic ignore rules help only when the file was created normally and never force-added.
stories.why_it_matters: Audit saved agent commands for embedded credentials, rotate exposed keys, and keep local permission files out of version control. Replace broad permanent approvals with narrow command patterns, then test repository checks against an intentionally harmless sample secret.

stories.summary: Dwarkesh Patel describes Clocktower, an author-designed social-deduction benchmark played across 386 games using roughly $20,000 in API credits. Its roles require cooperation, conflicting private information, and sometimes deception. stories.headline: A file-safe editing Skill puts recovery before replacement

source.title: AID-2026-0155: Claude Code deletes 15 years of Harvard law professor’s course materials
source.scope: Reviewed the incident chronology, original-post references, deletion scope, Dropbox recovery and database warning that the record remains draft and unverified.
source.freshness_reason: The accepted specific event falls inside 168 hours; the source is explicitly labeled draft and unverified, so the procedure is framed as a precaution rather than a verified causal diagnosis.

read_evidence.scope: Reviewed the incident chronology, original-post references, deletion scope, Dropbox recovery and database warning that the record remains draft and unverified.

stories.summary: A draft, unverified incident record says a professor returned to find years of course files deleted after an AI-assisted editing request; Dropbox recovery reportedly restored them. The account cannot establish the exact causal chain. It nevertheless exposes a useful control gap: editing requests should not authorize deletion, replacement, or movement of original folders by default.
stories.why_it_matters: Package file editing as a reusable Skill that snapshots inputs, works only on copies, returns a diff and changed-file inventory, and pauses before replacement. Validate the backup and original inventory before approving any final move.
stories.related_coverage: Reviewed the draft incident chronology, linked original account, reported recovery and explicit verification limitation.
stories.image_alt_intent: An original folder and verified backup remain locked while an editable copy produces a diff for approval.

audience_fit.intended_user: A teacher, researcher or office worker asking an assistant to revise a folder of documents.
audience_fit.practical_action: Run the editing request against a verified working copy rather than the source folder.
audience_fit.review_action: Check the diff, changed-file inventory, backup and original inventory before replacement.
audience_fit.usable_outcome: A reviewed edited copy and audit log without destructive changes to originals.

stories.agent_skills_evidence: Input a source folder, named target files, requested edits and a verified backup location. Snapshot the source inventory and duplicate the targets into a working copy. Forbid delete, overwrite or move operations on originals. Edit only the copy, then return a diff, changed-file list and unresolved items. A human validates the backup and original inventory before approving replacement. Output the approved copy and audit log.
